trend.basis: The national model's weekly estimate of true support, from the 2023 election result to the week of the last poll data. It is built from the polls and is not an average of them. The band is the 90% range.

limitations: This shows how the parties would do if the election were held under current conditions; it is not a forecast of how opinion will change before election day.
Ranges are central ranges across simulated elections under the current state of the polls; they are not margins of error.
General electorates without a seat poll rest on the 2023 result on the 2026 boundaries and the national picture.
Māori electorates with a seat poll show one chance of winning, from the Māori seat-poll model; a variance-inflated alternative (winProbabilityInflation) is in this file but not on the site.
Māori electorates without a seat poll carry their 2023 result forward, with no seat poll and wide uncertainty that is not calibrated for an election-wide shift like 2023.

national.basis: National polls to 2026-10-18 (weekly refresh of 2026-10-18); latent support in the week of 2026-10-04
